subject.title: fix(discord): retry reply session init conflicts to prevent silent message loss

question: Should Discord retain a transport-level replay guard if the shared reply-session self-heal in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101920 is selected?
rationale: Both approaches target the same initialization conflict at different ownership layers, and repository policy favors one canonical path rather than an unplanned fallback stack.

options.title: Prefer shared recovery
options.body: Use the shared session self-heal as canonical and retain Discord replay only if proof demonstrates a residual rejected-event case it cannot recover.

options.title: Keep both recovery layers
options.body: Land an abort-safe Discord retry as explicit defense in depth and document why its retry budget remains necessary after shared recovery.

recommendation.title: Prefer shared recovery
recommendation.body: Use the shared session self-heal as canonical and retain Discord replay only if proof demonstrates a residual rejected-event case it cannot recover.

likelyOwner.reason: Current-main history provides the strongest available routing signal for the affected Discord message-processing surface.
